scope: All frozen ASAR and external JS/MJS/CJS/CSS/JSON/map files; ASAR-unpacked disk duplicates excluded

method.javascript: Babel comments from complete file parse

limitations: Released-file source maps do not establish original repository build inputs or upstream modifications.
